## Long form table T19

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: true

file_name[[11]]
T19 <- file.path(file_name[[11]]) %>% 
  read_csv() %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(studyid = arb_person_id,
         visitdate = ymd(str_sub(encounter_date, 1, 10))) %>%
  arrange(studyid, visitdate, arb_encounter_id) %>%
  group_by(studyid, visitdate) %>%
  mutate(seqno = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(seqno == 1) %>%  # Keep first record per day
  select(-seqno) %>%
  arrange(studyid, visitdate, arb_encounter_id) %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(visitno = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

T19 <- T19 %>% 
  mutate(censored = deceased_yn == "Y",
         right_censored = as.logical(max(censored, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(dod_str = if_else(censored, as.character(cdphe_dod), NA_character_),
         dod_str = if_else(censored & is.na(dod_str), as.character(date_of_death_emr), dod_str),
         dod = suppressWarnings(ymd(dod_str))) %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(right_censored = max(censored, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

T0 <- T19 %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(fu_d = as.numeric(visitdate - first(visitdate)),
         fu_m = fu_d / 30.5,
         fu_yr = fu_m / 12) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(insurcat = case_when(payor_financial_class == "Medicare" ~ 0,
      payor_financial_class %in% c("Colorado Medicaid", "Out of State Medicaid") ~ 3,
      payor_financial_class %in% c("Managed Medicaid", "Managed Care", "Managed Medicare", "Commercial") ~ 1,
      payor_financial_class %in% c("Worker's Comp", "Tricare", "Indigent Care", "Special Accounts") ~ 5,
      payor_financial_class %in% c("UCHEALTH EMPLOYEE PLAN", "CU - UA NET") ~ 4,
      payor_financial_class == "Self-Pay" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(visitno = row_number(),
         d_insur = insurcat - lag(insurcat),
         change_insur = if_else(!is.na(d_insur), d_insur != 0, FALSE),
         change_coverage = max(change_insur, na.rm = TRUE),
         insurcat2 = if_else(insurcat >= 4, 4, insurcat)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(zip_code_new = as.integer(factor(zip_code))) %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  arrange(visitno, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(d_zip = zip_code_new - lag(zip_code_new),
         change_zip_code = if_else(!is.na(zip_code) & !is.na(d_zip), d_zip != 0, FALSE),
         relocate = max(change_zip_code, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

T0_tvT1 <- T0 %>%
  select(studyid, visitdate, 
         visitno, dod, censored, 
         right_censored,
         insurcat, change_insur, 
         change_coverage, zip_code,
         change_zip_code, relocate)

# Save
write_parquet(T0_tvT1, "data/T0_TempTable_tvT1.parquet")
write_parquet(T0, "data/T0_TempTable.parquet")
```

## Table1 T1

Table1 L424 to L764

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: true

## Ask alison about the encounterdate and the transferindate
T1 <- file.path(file_name[[1]]) %>% 
  read_csv() %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(studyid = arb_person_id) %>%
  relocate(studyid, .before = arb_person_id) %>%
  # filter(birth_date != "") %>% View()
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(dup_id = n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(cohort2 = cohort_1_or_2,
         cohort2 = if_else(is.na(cohort2), 0, cohort2),
         cohort2 = as.integer(cohort2)) %>%
  mutate(female = case_when(
    sex == "Female" ~ 1,
    sex == "Male" ~ 0,
    ## 2 is unknown
    TRUE ~ 2),
    # recode unknown as male
    female = if_else(female == 2, 0, female)) %>% 
  mutate(dob = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(birth_date, 
                                                orders = c("mdy", "ymd"))),
         birth_yr = year(dob)) %>%
  mutate(race_cat1 = case_when(race == "Black or African American" ~ 2,
                               race %in% c("Asian Indian", 
                                           "Chinese", 
                                           "Filipino",
                                           "Guamanian or Chamorro",
                                           "Japanese", 
                                           "Korean", 
                                           "Vietnamese", 
                                           "Other Asian") ~ 3,
                               race %in% c("American Indian or Alaska Native", 
                                           "Native Hawaiian", 
                                           "Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander", 
                                           "Other Pacific Islander",
                                           "Samoan") ~ 5,
                               race %in% c("Patient Declined", 
                                           "Unknown", "") ~ 4,
                               race %in% c("More Than One Race",
                                           "Other") ~ 1,
                               # Default to White
                               TRUE ~ 0),
         race_cat2 = if_else(race_cat1 == 5L, 3L, race_cat1)) %>%
  mutate(lang_cat = case_when(primary_language == "Spanish" ~ 1L,
                              primary_language == "English" ~ 0L,
                              primary_language %in% c("*Unspecified", "Unknown") ~ 3L,
                              TRUE ~ 2L),
    lang_help = (need_interpreter == "Y"))

race_labels1 <- c("0" = "White", 
                  "1" = "1+ race| ot", 
                  "2" = "Black", 
                  "3" = "Asian", 
                  "4" = "Unknown", 
                  "5" = "Indigent| Islander")

race_labels2 <- c("0" = "White", 
                  "1" = "1+ race| ot",
                  "2" = "Black", 
                  "3" = "Asian| Indigent| Islander", 
                  "4" = "Unknown")

T1$race_cat1 <- factor(T1$race_cat1, 
                       levels = 0:5, 
                       labels = race_labels1)
T1$race_cat2 <- factor(T1$race_cat2, 
                       levels = 0:4,
                       labels = race_labels2)

# Keep key variables
T1_1 <- T1 %>%
  select(studyid, cohort2,
         dob, birth_yr, 
         female, race_cat2,
         lang_cat, lang_help) %>%
  arrange(studyid)


write_parquet(T1_1, "data/T1_person_cleaned.parquet")
write_parquet(T1, "data/T1_person_cleaned_full.parquet")
# save(T1, file = "data/T1_person_cleaned.rdata")
```


## Merge T0 T1

L766 - L818


```{r}
# View(T1_1)
# View(T0_tvT1)
Tmerg0_1 <- T1 %>%
  ## keep=.TRUE to track _merge-like info
  left_join(T0, keep = FALSE) %>%   
  mutate(.merge = case_when(!is.na(studyid) & !is.na(visitdate) ~ 3L, 
                            # in master only
                            !is.na(studyid) & is.na(visitdate) ~ 1L,  
                            # in using only
                            TRUE ~ 2L)) %>%
  filter(.merge != 1L) %>%
  relocate(visitdate, visitno, fu_m,
           zip_code, change_zip_code, relocate,
           insurcat, change_insur, change_coverage,
           censored, right_censored,
           dod, .after = lang_help) %>% 
  arrange(studyid, visitdate)


write_parquet(Tmerg0_1, "data/Tmerg0_1_working.parquet")
```


## Merge T0 T2

L818 - L1102

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
T2 <- file.path(file_name[[12]]) %>%
  read_csv() %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(studyid = arb_person_id,
         visitdate = ymd(str_sub(date, 1, 10))) %>%
  relocate(visitdate, .after = arb_person_id) %>%
  filter(!encounter_type %in% c("Anesthesia", 
                                "Anesthesia Event", 
                                "Patient Message", 
                                "Nurse Triage")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(tolower(provider_name), "diagnostic"),
         !str_detect(tolower(provider_name), "resident"),
         !str_detect(tolower(provider_name), "eye")) %>%
  arrange(studyid, visitdate, arb_encounter_id) %>%
  group_by(studyid, visitdate) %>%
  mutate(dupind = n() - 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(studyid, visitdate) %>%
  mutate(seqno = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(seqno == 1) %>%
  select(-seqno) %>%
  mutate(insurcat = case_when(payor_financial_class == "Medicare" ~ 0L,
                              payor_financial_class %in% c("Colorado Medicaid", 
                                                           "Out of State Medicaid") ~ 3L,
                              payor_financial_class %in% c("Managed Medicaid", 
                                                           "Managed Care", 
                                                           "Managed Medicare", 
                                                           "Commercial") ~ 1L,
                              payor_financial_class %in% c("Worker's Comp",
                                                           "Tricare", "Indigent Care", 
                                                           "Special Accounts") ~ 5L,
                              payor_financial_class %in% c("UCHEALTH EMPLOYEE PLAN", 
                                                           "CU - UA NET") ~ 4L,
                              payor_financial_class == "Self-Pay" ~ 2L,
                              TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
         insurcat2 = if_else(insurcat >= 4 & !is.na(insurcat),
                             4L, insurcat))

write_parquet(T2, "data/T2_encounter_clean.parquet")

Tmerg0_1_2 <- Tmerg0_1 %>% 
  left_join(T2, keep = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(merge_T102 = case_when(
      !is.na(arb_encounter_id) & !is.na(lang_help) ~ 3L,
      is.na(arb_encounter_id) & !is.na(lang_help) ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 2L)) %>%
  filter(merge_T102 != 1L)

write_parquet(Tmerg0_1_2, "data/Tmerg_0_1_2_working.parquet")
```
